analysis.one_line_summary: Creator demonstrates how to create bouncy waves using the Wavytalk Blowout Boost thermal round brush.
analysis.full_description: A Lebanese creator with voluminous brunette hair demonstrates how to style waves using the pink Wavytalk Blowout Boost thermal brush. She isolates a straight strand of hair, wraps it around the heated round barrel, rolls up, twists it down smoothly to reveal a defined bouncy curl, and praises the tool's volume and versatility.

analysis.transcript_full_original: Guys، بدي فرجيكن كيف فيكن يطلعلكن هيدول الـ waves كمان بالـ Wavytalk Blowout Boost. باخد هيدي الـ straight section، باخد الخصلة بحطها هيك، بوطيها علآخر، برجع بطلع، بعدين بفتح من هون و I twist و I twist كل الوقت. ليكوا قديه الـ curl بيطلع elegant! Obsessed! لأنه كمان بيعطينا volume كتير حلو، بيعطينا shape تاني. This brush can do it all!
analysis.transcript_full_english: Guys, I want to show you how you can get these waves also with the Wavytalk Blowout Boost. I take this straight section, I take the strand, place it like this, bring it down all the way, then roll back up, then I release from here and I twist and I twist all the way. Look at how elegant the curl turns out! Obsessed! Because it also gives us really nice volume, gives a different shape. This brush can do it all!
